Workflow.Name: Verify contact address with Byteplant (sample)
Workflow.Description: Runs when the address of a contact changes: checks it with Byteplant Address Validator, writes the verified address back to the standard address columns, and adds a note with everything Byteplant returned. Part of the Byteplant sample app.
